reason: The FHIR side carries gla, a three-letter ISO 639-2 tag that openEHR's languages code set - External_id ISO_639-1 - has no code for, so DV_ENCAPSULATED.Language_valid would reject it. No language is written at all rather than a terminology_id being invented for a code the code set does not hold, and the omission is reported. Converting the openEHR side back therefore carries no Attachment.language. The dv-encapsulated.language row declares the drop.
